subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three assertion repairs, do the workflow and security owners approve these fourteen immutable third-party action revisions for the affected privileged automation?
rationale: Source inspection verifies official provenance and identifies mechanical defects, but accepting new executable revisions that receive tokens, secrets, publishing access, scanning permissions, and agent credentials requires repository-owner judgment.

options.title: Repair and owner-review
options.body: Synchronize every stale assertion, run focused exact-head workflow checks, and obtain workflow and security owner approval before merge.

options.title: Replace the bot branch
options.body: Create a stable maintainer-controlled grouped dependency update if repeated Dependabot rebases cannot retain the coupled assertion repairs.

recommendation.title: Repair and owner-review
recommendation.body: Synchronize every stale assertion, run focused exact-head workflow checks, and obtain workflow and security owner approval before merge.
